Guides.Title: 龙虾进击亡语
Guides.Summary: 用复生保护龙虾，以进击召唤和左侧亡语串起完整野兽阵容。
Guides.EnglishSummary: Protect the Lobster with Reborn, then connect Rally summons and left-most Deathrattles.

EntryProfiles.Title: 简单模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 认识复生、左侧亡语与进击召唤的基本配合。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Learn the basic link between Reborn, the left-most Deathrattle, and Rally summons.
KeyDecisions: 先给美味龙虾复生，再补齐成型随从。
美味龙虾始终保持在最左侧。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Grant Reborn to Tasty Lobster before completing the lineup.
Keep Tasty Lobster in the left-most slot.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 购买机变甲虫
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Buy Sprightly Scarab

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出机变甲虫，为最左美味龙虾选择复生
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play Sprightly Scarab and grant Reborn to the left-most Tasty Lobster

RequiredActions.Instruction: 卖出完成教学的机变甲虫
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Sell the tutorial Sprightly Scarab

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出两张逐亡陆行鸟和暴虐巨蝎
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play both Deathstriders and Tyrant Scorpion

RequiredActions.Instruction: 保持美味龙虾位于战队最左侧
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Keep Tasty Lobster in the left-most warband slot

EntryProfiles.Title: 初级模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 用塑造法术主动触发战吼和亡语，累计美味龙虾成长，并在受控三连后完成七格阵容。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Use shaping spells to trigger Battlecries and Deathrattles, grow Tasty Lobster, and finish the seven-slot lineup after the controlled Triple.
KeyDecisions: 先用战吼塑造补好美味龙虾的复生。
亡语塑造优先选择最左侧美味龙虾，至少累计3层成长。
三连奖励优先补齐逐亡陆行鸟，成型时不要改变最左站位。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Use Battlecry Shaping to secure Reborn on Tasty Lobster first.
Target the left-most Tasty Lobster with Deathrattle Shaping until it reaches at least 3 growth.
Use the Triple reward to finish Deathstrider without moving the Lobster from the left-most slot.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 购买第三张囤食土狼，合成金色并获得六星三连奖励
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Buy the third Food Hoarder Hyena to form a Golden and earn a Tier 6 Triple Reward

RequiredActions.Instruction: 购买机变甲虫，并为美味龙虾选择复生
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Buy Sprightly Scarab and choose Reborn for Tasty Lobster

RequiredActions.Instruction: 完成发现后，摆出两张金色逐亡陆行鸟和暴虐巨蝎
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: After the Discover, field both Golden Deathstriders and Tyrant Scorpion

RequiredActions.Instruction: 保持美味龙虾位于战队最左侧
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Keep Tasty Lobster in the left-most warband slot

OfferSchedules.Label: 受控三连：六星奖励必定包含逐亡陆行鸟（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Controlled Triple: the Tier 6 reward must include Deathstrider (normal games use normal odds)

EntryProfiles.Title: 困难模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 在更早的开放局面中自行安排大型饰品、塑造法术与站位，完成龙虾亡语成长链。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Plan the Greater Trinket, shaping spells, and board order from an earlier open state to complete the Lobster Deathrattle chain.
KeyDecisions: 第8回合结束前保持至少3只野兽以拿到狼首连枷。
根据机变甲虫是否已上场，决定战吼塑造或亡语塑造的使用时机。
最终仍要让美味龙虾在最左侧并达到3层成长。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Keep at least three Beasts before ending turn 8 to access Wolfhead Flail.
Choose between Battlecry and Deathrattle Shaping based on whether Sprightly Scarab is already in play.
Finish with Tasty Lobster left-most and at 3 or more growth.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 结束第8回合，在大饰品候选中选择狼首连枷
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: End turn 8 and choose Wolfhead Flail from the Greater Trinket offer

RequiredActions.Instruction: 购买机变甲虫
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Buy Sprightly Scarab

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出机变甲虫，为最左美味龙虾选择复生
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play Sprightly Scarab and grant Reborn to the left-most Tasty Lobster

RequiredActions.Instruction: 卖出完成教学的机变甲虫
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Sell the tutorial Sprightly Scarab

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出两张逐亡陆行鸟和暴虐巨蝎
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play both Deathstriders and Tyrant Scorpion

RequiredActions.Instruction: 保持美味龙虾位于战队最左侧
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Keep Tasty Lobster in the left-most warband slot

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：四本酒馆第二次刷新必含美味龙虾（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the second Tier 4 refresh includes Tasty Lobster (normal games use normal odds)

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：四本三连发现必含五本核心贪食的瞪羚
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the Tier 4 Triple Reward includes Ravenous Hyena

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：升到五本后的三连发现必含六本核心逐亡陆行鸟
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the Tier 5 Triple Reward includes Deathstrider

OfferSchedules.Label: 大饰品池教学：战队至少3只野兽时必含狼首连枷（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Greater Trinket lesson: include Wolfhead Flail with at least 3 Beasts (normal games use normal odds)

Guides.Title: 法术磁力卫星
Guides.Summary: 用酒馆法术推动机械成长，再以发动和磁力卫星完成阵容。
Guides.EnglishSummary: Grow Mechs with Tavern spells, then finish through Activate and Magnetic Satellites.

EntryProfiles.Title: 简单模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 认识施法、卫星磁力与复映无人机发动的基本顺序。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Learn the basic order of spell casts, Satellite Magnetics, and Drone Duplicator's Activate.
KeyDecisions: 先打出复映无人机和炫彩机器人，再施放增益法术。
发动复映无人机后再安排关键磁力。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Play Drone Duplicator and Glambot before casting the buff spells.
Activate Drone Duplicator before committing the key Magnetic.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出复映无人机
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play Drone Duplicator

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出一张炫彩机器人
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play one Glambot

RequiredActions.Instruction: 发动复映无人机
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Activate Drone Duplicator

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对复映无人机施放维修作业
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Repair Job on Drone Duplicator

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对炫彩机器人施放防御者的仪式
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Defender's Rites on Glambot

EntryProfiles.Title: 初级模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 用回合结束和亡语塑造补充酒馆法术，把至少3次施法转化为卫星磁力并完成双炫彩核心。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Use end-of-turn and Deathrattle Shaping to generate Tavern Spells, convert at least three casts into Satellite Magnetics, and finish the double-Glambot core.
KeyDecisions: 回合结束塑造优先触发机鳍鱼人补充两张法术。
手牌缺维修作业时，用亡语塑造触发救援机器人。
施法前确认炫彩机器人已在场，并让总施法次数达到3。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Use End-of-Turn Shaping on Gearfin to generate two spells.
Use Deathrattle Shaping on Rescue Bot when Repair Job is missing.
Have Glambot in play before casting and reach three total Tavern Spell casts.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 施放无限潜力并选择发现当前等级随从
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Boundless Potential and choose the current-Tier minion Discover

RequiredActions.Instruction: 完成发现后，摆出第二张金色炫彩机器人及其余成型随从
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: After the Discover, field the second Golden Glambot and the remaining final minions

OfferSchedules.Label: 受控法术发现：无限潜力必定包含炫彩机器人（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Controlled spell Discover: Boundless Potential must include Glambot (normal games use normal odds)

EntryProfiles.Title: 困难模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 在开放局面中自行管理秘密蓝图、塑造法术与磁力落点，让施法成长和七格阵容同时达标。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Manage Secret Schematic, shaping spells, and Magnetic targets from an open state so spell growth and the seven-slot lineup complete together.
KeyDecisions: 第8回合结束前保持至少3个机械属性以拿到秘密蓝图。
先用塑造效果补法术，再决定法术施放和磁力落点。
至少完成3次酒馆法术施放，并保留两个炫彩机器人核心位。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Keep at least three Mechs before ending turn 8 to access Secret Schematic.
Generate spells through shaping before choosing cast and Magnetic targets.
Reach three Tavern Spell casts while preserving both Glambot core slots.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 结束第8回合，在大饰品候选中选择秘密蓝图
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: End turn 8 and choose Secret Schematic from the Greater Trinket offer

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出复映无人机
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play Drone Duplicator

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出一张炫彩机器人
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play one Glambot

RequiredActions.Instruction: 发动复映无人机
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Activate Drone Duplicator

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对复映无人机施放维修作业
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Repair Job on Drone Duplicator

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对炫彩机器人施放防御者的仪式
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Defender's Rites on Glambot

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：四本酒馆第二次刷新必含复映无人机（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the second Tier 4 refresh includes Drone Duplicator (normal games use normal odds)

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：四本三连发现必含五本核心霓彩机器人
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the Tier 4 Triple Reward includes Glambot

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：升到五本后的三连发现必含六本核心效用无人机
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the Tier 5 Triple Reward includes Utility Drone

OfferSchedules.Label: 大饰品池教学：战队至少3个机械属性时必含秘密蓝图（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Greater Trinket lesson: include Secret Schematic with at least 3 Mechs (normal games use normal odds)

Guides.Title: 酒馆成长吞噬
Guides.Summary: 强化酒馆中的恶魔，利用吞噬和发动把酒馆属性转移到战队。
Guides.EnglishSummary: Buff Tavern Demons, then move their stats into the warband through Devour and Activate.

EntryProfiles.Title: 简单模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 认识酒馆永久成长、吞噬与发动的基本先后顺序。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Learn the basic order of permanent Tavern growth, Devour, and Activate.
KeyDecisions: 先把法术施放到恶魔干扰者，再进行吞噬。
酒馆属性提高后再发动缚魂狱卒。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Cast the spell on Devilish Distractor before Devouring.
Activate Soulkeeping Jailer after the Tavern stats have grown.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对恶魔干扰者施放理性癫狂
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Methodical Madness on Devilish Distractor

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对酒馆恶魔施放尖利箭矢并触发吞噬
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Pointy Arrow on a Tavern Demon to trigger Devour

RequiredActions.Instruction: 发动缚魂狱卒
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Activate Soulkeeping Jailer

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出手牌中的四张成型恶魔
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play the four finishing Demons from hand

EntryProfiles.Title: 初级模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 用亡语塑造获取理性癫狂，把酒馆永久成长提升到+8/+8，再通过吞噬转移到最终恶魔阵容。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: Use Deathrattle Shaping to obtain Methodical Madness, raise permanent Tavern growth to +8/+8, then transfer it into the final Demon lineup through Devour.
KeyDecisions: 亡语塑造优先选择鬼影幻术师，补充理性癫狂。
生成的理性癫狂全部优先施放到金色恶魔干扰者。
酒馆成长达到+8/+8后，再刷新找牌并发动缚魂狱卒。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Target Imp-lusionist with Deathrattle Shaping to generate Methodical Madness.
Cast the generated copies on the Golden Devilish Distractor first.
Reach +8/+8 permanent Tavern growth before refreshing and activating Soulkeeping Jailer.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 在六级酒馆刷新一次，受控酒馆必定出现艾瑞达逃脱大师；购买后完成金色
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Refresh once at Tavern Tier 6; the controlled shop must offer Eredar Escapist, then buy it to complete the Golden

RequiredActions.Instruction: 摆出金色艾瑞达逃脱大师及其余成型恶魔
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Field the Golden Eredar Escapist and the remaining final Demons

OfferSchedules.Label: 受控刷新：六级酒馆第一次刷新必定出现艾瑞达逃脱大师（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Controlled refresh: the first Tier 6 refresh must offer Eredar Escapist (normal games use normal odds)

EntryProfiles.Title: 困难模式
EntryProfiles.LearningGoal: 在更早的开放局面中安排邪钢切肉斧、亡语塑造和吞噬时机，把酒馆成长完整转移到七格阵容。
EntryProfiles.EnglishLearningGoal: From an earlier open state, plan Felsteel Cleaver, Deathrattle Shaping, and Devour timing to transfer Tavern growth into the seven-slot lineup.
KeyDecisions: 第8回合结束前保持至少3个恶魔属性以拿到邪钢切肉斧。
用亡语塑造补充理性癫狂，并把酒馆永久成长推进到+8/+8。
只有在酒馆目标足够强时才发动缚魂狱卒完成属性转移。
EnglishKeyDecisions: Keep at least three Demons before ending turn 8 to access Felsteel Cleaver.
Use Deathrattle Shaping for Methodical Madness and push permanent Tavern growth to +8/+8.
Activate Soulkeeping Jailer only after the Tavern targets are strong enough.

RequiredActions.Instruction: 结束第8回合，在大饰品候选中选择邪钢切肉斧
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: End turn 8 and choose Felsteel Cleaver from the Greater Trinket offer

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对恶魔干扰者施放理性癫狂
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Methodical Madness on Devilish Distractor

RequiredActions.Instruction: 对酒馆恶魔施放尖利箭矢并触发吞噬
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Cast Pointy Arrow on a Tavern Demon to trigger Devour

RequiredActions.Instruction: 发动缚魂狱卒
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Activate Soulkeeping Jailer

RequiredActions.Instruction: 打出手牌中的四张成型恶魔
RequiredActions.EnglishInstruction: Play the four finishing Demons from hand

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：四本酒馆第二次刷新必含缚魂狱卒（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the second Tier 4 refresh includes Soulkeeping Jailer (normal games use normal odds)

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：四本三连发现必含五本核心灵巧的逃亡者
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the Tier 4 Triple Reward includes Deft Deserter

OfferSchedules.Label: 困难教学：升到五本后的三连发现必含六本核心艾瑞达逃亡者
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Difficult lesson: the Tier 5 Triple Reward includes Eredar Escapist

OfferSchedules.Label: 大饰品池教学：战队至少3个恶魔属性时必含邪钢切肉斧（实际游戏以正常概率为准）
OfferSchedules.EnglishLabel: Greater Trinket lesson: include Felsteel Cleaver with at least 3 Demons (normal games use normal odds)
